tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find Apify Actors (ready-made scrapers and data tools) an agent can call for a kind of web data, e.g. 'LinkedIn company headcount', 'Amazon prices', 'Google Maps leads with email'. Returns the best matches with website, price, output fields, required input, page and scoped MCP URL. Filter by website

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Everything published about one catalogue Actor: description, price, required and example input, output fields, MCP URL, configs for Claude Code/Cursor/VS Code/Codex, n8n workflow, SKILL.md and schema files, matching recipes.

tools.name: find_recipe
tools.description: Find step-by-step n8n recipes that move live web data into a destination (Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, HubSpot, email, Discord, webhook, Qdrant) for a task such as 'new Zillow listings to Slack', plus matching use cases and agent skills. Suggests Actors when no recipe fits.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: One recipe in full: what it does, the Actor and input it sends, schedule, de-duplication, setup steps, known limits and, with include_workflow=true, the importable n8n workflow JSON (built-in nodes only).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The catalogue's categories (leads, social, video, products, property, jobs, search, travel, developer utilities) with Actor counts and the main websites in each.

tools.name: list_websites
tools.description: Websites the catalogue covers, with the number of Actors for each, its page and one MCP URL bundling its main Actors. Filter by part of the name or by category.

tools.name: build_mcp_config
tools.description: Ready-to-paste config that adds chosen Actors (or a website's bundle) to an MCP client through Apify's hosted MCP server: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI or n8n AI Agent, with steps.

tools.name: troubleshoot
tools.description: Sourced fixes for errors when connecting Apify Actors to Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini CLI or n8n (401 unauthorized, 408 timeouts, 429, SSE endpoint gone, tools missing, result too large...).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-server" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools, get_tool, list_websites · Private data: get_tool · Public sink: search_tools, find_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools, get_tool, list_websites · Private data: get_tool · Public sink: search_tools, find_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
